propositions: The differ's body-equality dedup key is fitted with truncate_comment_body (plain 32767-char cap) while the Cloud send path fits with AdfCodec.fit_outbound (serialized ADF against 32000-byte budget, reserving space for RECONCILER_MARKER), causing keys to never match for over-length comments.

For a 43200-char input body the comparison key returns 32767 chars while the landed Jira body is 31753 chars due to marker budget, with divergence starting around plain length ~31.8k where ADF serialization first crosses its limit.

The divergence originated in commit 27b868ba55 (emersed-specific-mutt) which moved the send path off the shared truncation helper to use AdfCodec.fit_outbound while leaving the differ on truncate_comment_body.

The secondary body-equality dedup layer is structurally dead for over-length comments; a lost map write (crash between add_comment and record_comment_id) causes re-posts every pass because the keys never converge.

The fix restores the shared-fitter invariant on Cloud only: _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment now returns fit_comment_as_sent(body, AdfCodec.fit_outbound) matching exactly what the send path lands, while Data Center's comment fitter and all send paths remain untouched.
